name: Nicholas Axel Tanujaya
headline: About
introduction: My name is Nicholas Axel Tanujaya. I'm currently an undergraduate student at Bina Nusantara University majoring in Computer Science and Mathematics. During my undergrad, I have had the wonderful opportunity to collaborate with Prof. Haifeng Xu from the University of Chicago and Dr. Andrzej Kaczmarczyk from AGH University of Krakow.

I am broadly interested in algorithmic game theory, economics and computation, and multi-agent systems, with further interests in algorithms & complexity. A general theme in my research interests is the desire to model real-world scenarios mathematically with provable guarantees.
